The people behind it

One kitchen, one family, one menu.

Aangan is run by the Chaudhary family. Sunita ji handles the sabzi and the sweets, Rajveer ji runs the tandoor, and there is no third branch anywhere.

We cook to order, so a thali takes about fifteen minutes on a busy evening. If you are in a hurry, send a WhatsApp before you leave home and it will be ready when you sit down.

Ordering for a function?

We do bulk thali for pooja, havan and small weddings, with our own staff to serve. Tell us the date and the headcount.

Delivery

Free within 4 km of Holi Gate on orders above ₹500. Call the shop directly — we pack the gravy separately so nothing spills.

Timings

When we are open

The kitchen takes its last order thirty minutes before closing. The sweet and chai counter opens earlier than the kitchen.

Monday – Thursday11:00 am – 11:00 pm
Friday – Sunday10:00 am – 11:30 pm

On Janmashtami and Holi we stay open late. Timings for festival days are put up on our WhatsApp status.
